name: Mysterious Lover
source: Is it a mistake galling in love with one of the mysterious men? Does he hate me or want to protect me? His mesmerizing eyes have me drowning. He has secrets hidden in them. What do I do when being taken by his enemy?
translation: 爱上一位神秘男子是一个错误吗？他是恨我还是想保护我？他那双迷人的眼睛让我窒息。他的身上隐藏着秘密。当我被敌人抓住时我该怎么办？
